summary: A short wiki-derived note about the Bank of England, stating that in 1998 it became an independent public organisation. The organisation was wholly owned by the Treasury Solicitor on behalf of the government, and it gained independence in setting monetary policy.
one_line: The Bank of England became an independent public organisation in 1998, wholly owned by the Treasury Solicitor for the government, with monetary policy independence.
key_facts: In 1998, the Bank of England became an independent public organisation.
The Bank of England was wholly owned by the Treasury Solicitor on behalf of the government.
The Bank of England gained independence in setting monetary policy in 1998.
